Writes and reads Windows icons (.ico), cursors (.cur) and animated cursors (.ani) from encoded frames: bitmaps with a transparency mask below 256 px and a PNG at 256 px. The library behind the PatTech.IcoNet.Pipeline build step, for tools that produce icons themselves.

Builds multi-resolution Windows icons (.ico), cursors (.cur) and animated cursors (.ani) from PNG, BMP and SVG artwork during the build, driven by an icons.ini project file next to the artwork. Add the package and an icons.ini; the icons are rebuilt whenever the artwork changes.
